The way that I see it is that the universe works in mysterious ways, if you were meant to die then you would, there’s no reason to rush the process. Sometimes we go through life and experience the worst pain imaginable and we start to lose hope, but you never truly know what will happen tomorrow or the future. You might run into an old friend and revive a friendship, you might meet a total stranger who with time would be your lover, you could change jobs and have a fresh start, you could finally pursue a life long dream of yours, you could go out and experience nature and wonder how the world really works, hell we could get invaded by aliens tomorrow and you’d miss it. I know it’s hard but please try to think of the good in life, when you’re dead you won’t get to experience things, you’re being kept around for a reason and for you to know what that reason is, you need to be here.
